arguments.Prompt:
A hand-painted 2D game character animation sprite sheet arranged in exactly a 3-column by 2-row grid (6 poses total) on a solid, uniform vivid pure magenta background (#FF00FF). The character is a Hush Moth: a pure animal creature with raw magical oversized moth anatomy (no humanoid features, no clothes, no weapons, no hands, no human face). The creature features four ragged triangular midnight-blue wings with pale silver veins and faint moonlike markings, a small dark segmented chitinous body/thorax, and fine feathery antennae, with subtle restrained pale lilac wisps.

All 6 poses are depicted from a consistent front-right three-quarter perspective (head and body facing diagonally toward viewer and toward the right) from an elevated 55-degree orthographic angle.
The 6 resistance/defense poses show a continuous bracing animation sequence:
Row 1:
1. Ready poised stance with wings slightly flared.
2. Lower body lowers and braces against incoming impact.
3. Forelimbs plant firmly as the large moth wings fold forward defensively to shield the body.
Row 2:
4. Body withstands and absorbs force, wings held firm against the pressure.
5. Slight effort strain and adjustment in braced posture.
6. Steady solid braced hold, resilient and grounded.

Style: Stylized hand-painted digital dark fantasy concept art, sculpted opaque painterly volume, confident brushwork, clean edges with sharply selected silver specular highlights, cool upper-left directional lighting, small subtle contact shadows under feet. Consistent identical anatomical scale across all 6 poses.
Strict framing: Each pose is completely contained within its cell's middle 60%, with wide, completely empty pure magenta (#FF00FF) margins and gutters separating every pose. No cell borders, no dividing lines, no text, no labels, no UI, no ground plane or environment.
